trans-unit.source:
Are you sure you want the app to reset macOS display settings? The system will reboot after the reset.
Clearing NVRAM also removes low-level firmware preferences, such as startup disk and boot-related settings. macOS will recreate or reset them as appropriate after restart.
trans-unit.target:
क्या आप वाक़ई ऐप से macOS की डिस्प्ले सेटिंग्ज़ रीसेट करवाना चाहते हैं? रीसेट के बाद सिस्टम रीबूट होगा।
NVRAM साफ़ करने से स्टार्टअप डिस्क और बूट संबंधी सेटिंग्ज़ जैसी निचले स्तर की फ़र्मवेयर प्राथमिकताएँ भी हट जाती हैं। रीस्टार्ट के बाद macOS इन्हें ज़रूरत के अनुसार दोबारा बनाएगा या रीसेट करेगा।
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Confirmation text shown before resetting macOS display settings. It explains that either reset restarts the Mac and warns that the optional NVRAM action also clears low-level firmware preferences such as startup-disk and boot settings, which macOS recreates or resets after restart.

trans-unit.id: Extended luminance range and 16-bpc for greater color accuracy (default is 8-bpc, SDR). With an HDR compatible Color Profile (`Display P3` recommended), HDR content is preserved when mirroring to an HDR/EDR display. Full screen stream and PIP window with both `Video Filters` and `HDR Filter Pipeline` enabled show proper HDR content or can be manually tone-mapped using an appropriate `Exposure` filter to differentiate HDR luminances up to virtual 10.000 nits.
trans-unit.source: Extended luminance range and 16-bpc for greater color accuracy (default is 8-bpc, SDR). With an HDR compatible Color Profile (`Display P3` recommended), HDR content is preserved when mirroring to an HDR/EDR display. Full screen stream and PIP window with both `Video Filters` and `HDR Filter Pipeline` enabled show proper HDR content or can be manually tone-mapped using an appropriate `Exposure` filter to differentiate HDR luminances up to virtual 10.000 nits.
trans-unit.target: बेहतर रंग सटीकता के लिए विस्तृत ल्यूमिनेंस रेंज और 16-bpc (डिफ़ॉल्ट 8-bpc, SDR है)। HDR संगत रंग प्रोफ़ाइल (`Display P3` अनुशंसित) के साथ HDR/EDR डिस्प्ले पर मिररिंग करते समय HDR सामग्री बनी रहती है। फ़ुल स्क्रीन स्ट्रीम और PIP विंडो में `वीडियो फ़िल्टर` और `HDR फ़िल्टर पाइपलाइन`, दोनों चालू होने पर HDR सामग्री सही दिखती है। उपयुक्त `एक्सपोज़र` फ़िल्टर से मैनुअल टोन मैपिंग करके वर्चुअल 10,000 nits तक के HDR ल्यूमिनेंस स्तरों में अंतर भी दिखाया जा सकता है।

trans-unit.id: Sets the minimum allowed hardware brightness value (on its own scale) below which software dimming kicks in when using combined brightness control. This setting is useful for those with PWM sensitivity as it prohibits backlight control from entering the heavy PWM range, substituting it with software dimming instead.
trans-unit.source: Sets the minimum allowed hardware brightness value (on its own scale) below which software dimming kicks in when using combined brightness control. This setting is useful for those with PWM sensitivity as it prohibits backlight control from entering the heavy PWM range, substituting it with software dimming instead.

trans-unit.id: This configures how the data associated with the currently configured display is matched to a detected display during the configuration/detection process. Changing this setting might cause a display to be recognized as previously unconnected and disassociate existing saved display configuration data. System UUID match uses the macOS default identification. When set to use basic identifiers, the app identifies the display by its vendor/model IDs and serial number. With extended it also uses product name, alphanumeric serial number, and production date. With port and location the app also considers hardware connectivity data.
trans-unit.source: This configures how the data associated with the currently configured display is matched to a detected display during the configuration/detection process. Changing this setting might cause a display to be recognized as previously unconnected and disassociate existing saved display configuration data. System UUID match uses the macOS default identification. When set to use basic identifiers, the app identifies the display by its vendor/model IDs and serial number. With extended it also uses product name, alphanumeric serial number, and production date. With port and location the app also considers hardware connectivity data.

trans-unit.id: When HDR upscaling is enabled while hardware brightness control is disabled, the app uses a continuous brightness scale between zero and the calibrated max upscale value. Due to this the neutral setting (100⁠% brightness, when on-screen HDR content is unclipped) might not fall to an OSD chiclet boundary which makes it difficult to attain via the shortcut keys. To fix this an additional mid-chiclet step at 100⁠% brightness is inserted.
trans-unit.source: When HDR upscaling is enabled while hardware brightness control is disabled, the app uses a continuous brightness scale between zero and the calibrated max upscale value. Due to this the neutral setting (100⁠% brightness, when on-screen HDR content is unclipped) might not fall to an OSD chiclet boundary which makes it difficult to attain via the shortcut keys. To fix this an additional mid-chiclet step at 100⁠% brightness is inserted.
trans-unit.target: हार्डवेयर ब्राइटनेस नियंत्रण बंद होने के दौरान HDR अपस्केलिंग चालू होने पर ऐप शून्य से कैलिब्रेट किए गए अधिकतम अपस्केल मान तक लगातार ब्राइटनेस स्केल इस्तेमाल करता है। इसलिए तटस्थ सेटिंग (100⁠% ब्राइटनेस, जब स्क्रीन पर HDR सामग्री क्लिप नहीं होती) OSD खंड की सीमा पर न आए, ऐसा हो सकता है, जिससे शॉर्टकट कुंजियों से उस तक पहुँचना कठिन होता है। इसे ठीक करने के लिए 100⁠% ब्राइटनेस पर खंड के बीच एक अतिरिक्त चरण जोड़ा जाता है।

trans-unit.id:
⚠️ An EDID write operation modifies the EDID and DisplayID data on the device itself. Erroneous EDID data or a problem during EDID write might render the display permanently unusable!
Most displays do not allow EDID write for security reasons, some displays require EDID write to be activated in a service menu. Most EDID emulators or pass-thru dongles support EDID write. EDID write (if supported) usually works over HDMI.
trans-unit.source:
⚠️ An EDID write operation modifies the EDID and DisplayID data on the device itself. Erroneous EDID data or a problem during EDID write might render the display permanently unusable!
Most displays do not allow EDID write for security reasons, some displays require EDID write to be activated in a service menu. Most EDID emulators or pass-thru dongles support EDID write. EDID write (if supported) usually works over HDMI.

⚠️ EDID लिखने से डिवाइस पर ही मौजूद EDID और DisplayID डेटा बदल जाता है। गलत EDID डेटा या लिखते समय कोई समस्या होने से डिस्प्ले स्थायी रूप से अनुपयोगी हो सकता है!
सुरक्षा कारणों से अधिकांश डिस्प्ले EDID लिखने की अनुमति नहीं देते। कुछ डिस्प्ले में सर्विस मेनू से EDID लेखन सक्रिय करना पड़ता है। अधिकांश EDID एम्युलेटर या पास-थ्रू डोंगल EDID लेखन का समर्थन करते हैं। EDID लेखन (यदि समर्थित हो) आम तौर पर HDMI पर काम करता है।
